notes:
Lead: CTO Alex Ren. Looking to replace brittle keyword search with hybrid RAG pipeline. Priority: high recall at scale + sub-100ms rerank p50 for 95% of queries. Current infra: Elastic on-prem for docs + Postgres for metadata; proof-of-concept evaluated Pinecone SaaS but worried about data residency and egress costs.

Requirements (verbatim from call): "We need 100M+ vectors indexed, per-tenant isolation, incremental sync within 2 min, and a rerank stage that can run on GPU for priority queries."

Preferred embedding dims: 1536 (Open model) but open to 3072 for internal models. Candidate retrieval plan: BM25 -> topK 100 vector retrieval -> cross-encoder rerank (Distil/miniLM or small fine-tuned BERT on GPU depending on latency). Target cost per query: <$0.002 average; latency SLO: p50 <100ms, p95 <250ms.

Connector wishlist: bulk idempotent import, change-data-capture (CDC) for doc updates, metadata filters, per-namespace quotas, muted fallbacks when index not available, on-prem connector that can run in air-gapped mode, health checks and metrics exposed to Redwood Console.

Notes style: shorthand, action items. Security team requested SOC2 + KMS integration, audit log export (90d) and EU residency. Legal flagged vendor SLA clauses around deletion/erasure compliance.

Quote from CTO: "If we can get consistent sub-100ms rerank for our support flows, we can roll to 60% of our customers in Q4."
